verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Internal Agent analyzes your last 100-1,000 resolved tickets and "researches everything you've connected" to automatically build baseline knowledge, memory, and tools, with versioned live knowledge. This covers past-ticket ingestion without manual re-authoring. However, no evidence explicitly names help-center, product-doc, or internal-wiki connectors as knowledge sources. missing for 10: explicit help center/docs ingestion, internal wiki connectors (e.g. Notion/Confluence), sync/refresh behavior for knowledge sources, independent corroboration.
